AboutPage.title: About Seedream 4.5
AboutPage.description: Seedream 4.5 is ByteDance's latest iteration of advanced AI image generation and editing model, released on December 3, 2025. It represents a major upgrade focusing on professional-grade tools for creators, designers, and marketers.
AboutPage.authorBio: AI Image Generation & Editing by ByteDance
AboutPage.introduction: Seedream 4.5 is the latest iteration of ByteDance's (the company behind TikTok) advanced AI image generation and editing model. It integrates text-to-image generation and image editing into a unified system, emphasizing cinematic realism, precise prompt adherence, and high-fidelity outputs suitable for production workflows.

features.title: Key Features and Improvements
features.subtitle: Professional-grade AI tools for creators
features.description: Seedream 4.5 represents a major upgrade with cutting-edge capabilities designed for production workflows

item-1.title: Enhanced Prompt Adherence
item-1.description: Better understands complex instructions, including multi-step prompts and up to 14 reference images, while maintaining consistency in elements like faces, textures, and lighting.

item-2.title: Cinematic Aesthetics
item-2.description: Produces 4K-ready visuals (up to 4096×4096 resolution) with realistic depth, lighting, color palettes, and material rendering—ideal for fashion, product showcases, or editorial content.

item-3.title: Superior Text Rendering
item-3.description: Handles typography accurately, making it great for posters, brand visuals, and labels with small text (e.g., ingredient lists).

item-4.title: Multi-Image Consistency
item-4.description: Supports controllable edits across multiple images, preserving facial features, spatial logic, and scene details without random failures in complex scenarios.

features2.title: Advanced AI Capabilities
features2.subtitle: Next-generation image technology
features2.description: Experience the power of state-of-the-art AI models trained on millions of high-quality images

features3.description: Everything you need to create, edit, and perfect your visual content in one powerful platform

item-1.title: AI-Powered Upscaling
item-1.description: Enhance image resolution up to 4K while maintaining sharpness and detail quality

item-3.title: Advanced Color Grading

item-5.title: Version Control
item-5.description: Track changes, compare variations, and revert to any previous version instantly

item-6.title: Team Collaboration

item-1.question: What image formats does Seedream 4.5 support?
item-1.answer: Seedream 4.5 supports all major formats including PNG, JPEG, WebP, and TIFF. You can generate images up to 4096×4096 resolution and export in your preferred format.

item-2.question: How do credits work?
item-2.answer: Each image generation or edit consumes credits based on complexity and resolution. Free users get 50 credits monthly, Pro users get 1000 credits, and you can purchase additional credit packages anytime.

item-3.question: Can I use generated images commercially?
item-3.answer: Yes! All images you create with Seedream 4.5 are yours to use for commercial purposes. Pro and Lifetime users get extended licensing rights.

item-4.question: What's the refund policy?
item-4.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for all paid plans. If you're not satisfied with Seedream 4.5, contact our support team for a full refund.

item-5.question: Need help or have questions?
item-5.answer: Our support team is here to help! Contact us at support@seedream4-5.io or visit our documentation for tutorials and guides.

testimonials.title: Loved by Creators Worldwide
testimonials.subtitle: See what our users are saying

item-1.name: Sarah Chen
item-1.quote: Seedream 4.5 has completely transformed my creative workflow. The image quality is incredible and the AI understands exactly what I want.

item-2.name: Marcus Johnson
item-2.quote: We've cut our content creation time in half. The ability to generate on-brand visuals at scale is a game-changer for our team.

item-3.name: Elena Rodriguez
item-3.quote: The text rendering feature is mind-blowing. I can finally create product mockups with perfect typography in seconds.

item-4.name: David Park
item-4.quote: As a social media creator, I need fresh content daily. Seedream 4.5 helps me maintain quality while meeting tight deadlines.

item-5.name: Aisha Patel
item-5.quote: The consistency across image sets is remarkable. We can now maintain visual coherence across all our campaign materials.

item-6.name: Tom Anderson
item-6.quote: The integration with Figma saves me hours every week. I can generate and iterate on visual concepts without leaving my design tool.

item-7.name: Lisa Wong
item-7.quote: Product photography has never been easier. We can create professional-looking product shots in any setting imaginable.

item-8.name: James Miller
item-8.quote: The 4K output quality is exceptional. We use Seedream 4.5 for everything from social posts to large-format print campaigns.

item-9.name: Nina Kowalski
item-9.quote: The inpainting tool is incredibly intelligent. It understands lighting and perspective better than any tool I've used before.

item-10.name: Ahmed Hassan
item-10.quote: Perfect for generating hero images and illustrations for web projects. The style consistency is exactly what designers need.

item-11.name: Sophie Martin
item-11.quote: I use Seedream 4.5 to explore concepts before committing to final illustrations. It's like having an infinite mood board.

item-12.name: Carlos Rivera
item-12.quote: The cinematic quality and attention to fabric textures is incredible. It's become essential for my design presentations.
